description: USB HID activity jiggler for CardputerZero

store.summary: Keep a host computer awake by jiggling mouse/keyboard activity over USB
store.description: Jiggler uses CardputerZero's host/slave switchable USB port to imitate a USB mouse and/or keyboard, sending small periodic movements/pulses so a connected computer does not go idle or lock. Start/stop and configure everything with the five keys under the screen (4-8) - no touch or mouse required. On the desktop emulator, jiggling is simulated only; real USB HID output (via /dev/hidg0 / /dev/hidg1) is implemented but unverified since CardputerZero hardware has not shipped yet.
